recent_articles.title: Delhi LG asks to explore inducting ex-Agniveers to strengthen fire department | Delhi News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Lieutenant Governor Taranjit Singh Sandhu** suggested that **former Agniveers** could be inducted to address the Delhi Fire Service's (DFS) manpower shortage and increase fire stations.  The suggestion came during a high-level meeting of the Delhi Disaster Management Authority (DDMA), which also included **Chief Minister Rekha Gupta**, and reviewed ongoing anti-encroachment drives, fire safety regulations, and future disaster preparedness. The DFS faces a significant vacancy rate, with 1,030 out of 3,633 sanctioned posts currently unfilled.  **Sandhu** directed the department to ensure that complaints regarding harassment of legitimate structures are addressed carefully, while also emphasizing the need for swift action against illegal construction and unauthorized land plotting.

recent_articles.title: To turn roads dust-free, Delhi government signs MoU for scientific road management | Delhi News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Minister Rekha Gupta** signed a Memorandum of Agreement (MOA) with **Central Road Research Institute (CRRI)** and **School of Planning and Architecture (SPA)** to develop a standard framework for paving urban roads. The agreement aims to address challenges like traffic, air pollution, and waterlogging through scientific data-driven methods.  The collaboration will lead to the development of scientific green belts along roadsides, rainwater harvesting systems, and sustainable landscaping practices. **CRRI** will provide technical support in road engineering and asset management, while **SPA** will offer guidance on urban design and green infrastructure.

recent_articles.title: After Delhi Hotel Fire Kills 21, Big Move Against Government Officials
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Following the Malviya Nagar fire tragedy that killed 21 people, the **Delhi** government has warned officials may face financial liability for negligence.  The government will invoke provisions of the Revenue Recovery Act and Disaster Management Act to recover losses from property owners and negligent officials. The move comes as investigators examine whether regulatory failures, illegal construction, and safety violations played a role in the tragedy. District Magistrates will be empowered to coordinate enforcement and identify responsibility across departments. The government has also ordered inspections of hotels, guest houses, restaurants, and Bed and Breakfast establishments across Delhi.

recent_articles.title: 3 killed as crane overturns on under construction flyover linking Noida airport to Faridabad | Delhi News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Abhimanyu Hazarika**, a Senior Correspondent for **The Indian Express**, covers southern Haryana. His recent reporting has focused on crime, environmental policy, and urban infrastructure issues in the region. He recently covered the recovery of explosives and an AK-47 linked to the 2025 Red Fort car explosion case, protests against a Supreme Court order that could allow mining and real estate development on Aravalli hills, and concerns regarding low budget allocated for stray dog sterilization by the Municipal Corporation of Gurugram.

recent_articles.title: Malviya Nagar fire: CM Rekha Gupta meet victims, announces compensation; LG hold high-level meet | Delhi News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Minister Rekha Gupta** announced an ex-gratia of Rs 10 lakh for the families of the victims and Rs 5 lakh for those injured in a fire at **Flourish Stays**, a bed-and-breakfast facility in South Delhi.  **Gupta** directed departments to conduct a thorough investigation, audit fire safety standards, and take strict action against negligence. The **Lieutenant Governor Taranjit Singh Sandhu** chaired a meeting with the **Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD)** to discuss a comprehensive plan for stronger urban governance, improved infrastructure, and enhanced structural safety across Delhi.  The LG directed the MCD to implement a time-bound strategy to detect and demolish unauthorized constructions.

recent_articles.title: After South Delhi building collapse, CM asks MCD Commissioner to conduct citywide audit | Delhi News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Following a building collapse in Saidulajab that killed six people, **Chief Minister Rekha Gupta** has ordered a comprehensive audit of all unauthorized constructions across Delhi. The audit will be conducted by the **Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD)** and will focus on residential, commercial, and market areas.  Gupta has also directed an immediate survey and inspection of dilapidated buildings in the area to ensure public safety and hold officials accountable for any negligence or violations.

recent_articles.title: Delhi Confidential: Spiritual Bond | Delhi Confidential News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rabi Lamichhane**, chairman of the **Rastriya Swatantra Party (RSP)**, visited the **BJP** office in Delhi on Tuesday.  Senior BJP leaders including **Rekha Gupta**, **Harsh Malhotra**, and several MPs welcomed the delegation. The **VHP** renewed its demand for denying benefits to tribals who converted to other religions, citing a recent event where **Amit Shah**, Union Home Minister, attended a rally organized by an RSS-linked organization.  Delhi Police Commissioner **Satish Golchha** directed all district DCPs to address water and power disruption complaints with urgency.

recent_articles.title: Cultural ties, Gen Z politics on table as Nepal’s RSP meets BJP chief Nitin Nabin | India News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rabi Lamichhane**, Chairman of the **Rastriya Swatantra Party (RSP)**, met with **Nitin Nabin**, president of the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** and Delhi Chief Minister **Rekha Gupta** in New Delhi as part of a 'KNOW BJP' initiative. The meeting focused on strengthening democratic dialogue between the two parties and exploring the role of Gen Z in politics.  **Vijay Chauthaiwale**, BJP foreign affairs department in-charge, also participated in the discussions, highlighting the party’s organizational structure and grassroots engagement.

recent_articles.title: Delhi Government Reshuffles Over 40 Staff In Health Procurement Agency
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Delhi**'s government has transferred over 40 personnel from the **Central Procurement Agency (CPA)** as part of a restructuring initiative aimed at improving efficiency and transparency in the health sector. The move includes the transfer of 10 doctors, 19 paramedical employees, and 10 administrative staff, with additional responsibilities assigned to officers handling various units within the agency.  **Chief Minister Rekha Gupta** stated that the government is committed to strengthening the procurement and supply system for medicines and medical equipment, ensuring timely healthcare services for residents of the national capital.

recent_articles.title: Delhi Confidential: Mandarin Connect | Delhi Confidential News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Vikram Doraiswami**, newly appointed Indian ambassador to China, has begun engaging with Chinese social media audiences by introducing the Indian embassy in Beijing and its facilities.  He is using his fluent Mandarin skills, honed during his time in China as a diplomat, to connect with the audience. Meanwhile, **Asaduddin Owaisi**, chief of the AIMIM party, has warned **Shaukat Ali**, state unit chief, that he will be removed if the party's performance in Uttar Pradesh does not improve before upcoming elections.

recent_articles.title: Delhi CM visits building collapse site, orders action on all illegal buildings - Delhi News | India Today
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta** visited the Saket building collapse site on Sunday, ordering a criminal case and a magisterial inquiry into the incident.  Following her visit, **Gupta** directed authorities to inspect dilapidated buildings in the area and take action against unauthorized constructions. The **CMO Delhi**, along with **Lieutenant Governor Taranjit Singh Sandhu** and **Home Minister Ashish Sood**, confirmed that rescue teams were continuing operations and providing medical assistance to those affected.

recent_articles.title: Saket Building Collapse: 4 Dead In Delhi Building Collapse, Rescue Ops On For Over 16 Hours
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A five-storey building collapsed near the Saket Metro station in South Delhi, killing four people and injuring over 10 others.  **Rekha Gupta**, **Chief Minister of Delhi**, visited the site to review rescue efforts and ordered a criminal case against the building's owner for culpable homicide. Rescue teams are using heavy machinery and sniffer dogs to search for survivors. The building housed a coaching institute, cafes, and offices, with construction underway on the upper floor at the time of the incident.

recent_articles.title: Haryana government has assured to maintain 1,000 cusecs of water supply through Munak Canal: Delhi CM | Delhi News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Haryana** Chief Minister Rekha Gupta assured that the state will supply 1,000 cusecs of water to **Delhi** daily through the Munak Canal.  The **Delhi Jal Board (DJB)** is currently producing around 900-924 cusecs of water per day, but faces a shortfall of over 300 MGD during peak summer. The DJB has been working to maintain production and ensure minimal disruption for residents, while also addressing complaints related to water scarcity. **Water Minister Parvesh Sahib Singh** highlighted the challenges posed by the low Yamuna water level at Wazirabad Barrage, but emphasized efforts to sustain water production.  The CM directed officials to address all water leakage complaints and deploy more tankers in affected areas.

recent_articles.title: Building collapses near Saket metro station; 8 persons rescued, several feared trapped - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: An eight-story building collapsed in Saket, Delhi on Saturday evening, trapping several people under the debris. **Delhi Fire Services** officials responded to the scene and rescued at least eight individuals.  The incident occurred near a tin shed canteen where children were dining, creating panic and prompting a large-scale rescue operation involving multiple agencies including **National Disaster Response Force**, **Delhi Police**, and **District Disaster Management Authority**.

recent_articles.title: PM austerity appeal: State leaders take steps to limit their fuel use - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, **Union Home Minister Amit Shah**, and several other state chief ministers have implemented measures to reduce fuel consumption in response to the West Asia crisis.  These include reducing convoy sizes, promoting electric vehicles, and encouraging public transport use. **Yogi Adityanath**, **Rekha Gupta**, **Mohan Yadav**, and others have also taken steps to promote sustainability within their respective states.  **Devendra Fadnavis**, **Harsh Sanghavi**, and **Acharya Devvrat** have implemented similar measures in Maharashtra, Gujarat, and Bihar respectively.

recent_articles.title: West Bengal Cabinet 2026: From Dilip Ghosh to Agnimitra Paul, Ministers who were sworn in along with Suvendu Adhikari - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Suvendu Adhikari**, newly sworn in as the Chief Minister of West Bengal, inducted five new ministers into his cabinet on Saturday. The swearing-in ceremony was attended by **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, **Union Ministers Amit Shah, Rajnath Singh, J. P. Nadda, and Dharmendra Pradhan**, among other BJP leaders.  **Dilip Ghosh**, a senior BJP leader who secured victory in the Kharagpur seat, **Agnimitra Paul**, a fashion designer-turned-legislator who won Asansol Dakshin, **Ashok Kirtania**, a BJP stalwart who gained victory in Bangaon Uttar, and **Kshudiram Tudu**, a former school teacher from Ranibandh (ST) constituency, were among the newly appointed ministers.  **Nisith Pramanik**, a key face of BJP from North Bengal, was also inducted into the cabinet.

recent_articles.title: Delhi to host 2026 Commonwealth Table Tennis Championship - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Delhi** will host the 22nd Commonwealth Table Tennis Championship in July and August of 2026, with over 35 countries expected to participate. **Chief Minister Rekha Gupta** announced the event at the Delhi Secretariat, stating that the city has a strong history of hosting international sporting events. The seven-day championship will be held at the Thyagraj Stadium and feature competitions across multiple categories, culminating in finals on August 2nd.  The tournament is being organized jointly by the **Delhi government** and the **Table Tennis Federation of India**, with officials anticipating participation from countries like England, Australia, and Canada.

recent_articles.title: Delhi CM hails TTD for its pilgrim-centric initiatives - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta** visited the **Tirumala temple** in Andhra Pradesh on Wednesday and offered prayers to Lord Venkateswara. She praised the temple administration for its pilgrim-centric initiatives and commended the use of AI technology at the Integrated Command Control Centre.  **Ms. Gupta** also spoke about the 33% Women’s Reservation Bill, calling it a historic reform that will accelerate national progress.

recent_articles.title: Delhi Budget 2026: Fiscal deficit widens by 62% in 2025-26 as revenue falls - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Delhi’s** fiscal deficit for 2025–26 has increased by 62.65% to ₹22,289.03 crore in the revised estimate (RE), compared to the budget estimate (BE) of ₹13,702.95 crore presented last year. The increase is attributed to a fall in expected revenue, which has dropped from ₹81,545.83 crore (BE) to ₹71,844.99 crore (RE). **Chief Minister Rekha Gupta** presented the revised budget on Tuesday, projecting a fiscal deficit of ₹16,966.29 crore for 2026–27.  Despite this increase, the Delhi government's debt-to-GSDP ratio remains the lowest in the country.
